scope: The 125 retained fixed-energy rows routed through ready100 (96), approved ALeCS manifests (23), and Zhong-Bose (6). Does not claim these are all rows whose distant provenance includes Bose.
carrier: Bose dissertation Appendix A Table A.7, PDF pages 329-355 / printed 287-313
column_proof: Table A.7 heading and columns identify number of interlab data, Mean cross section A^2, and 95% confidence interval. PDF p329 says own-laboratory values use n-hexane calibration. Section 2.3.1 PDF pp58-59 documents experimental laboratory standardization. These are not the preceding model-prediction figure data.
replay_method: Existing PDF word-coordinate mean-column extractor (x0 435-475) replayed across Table A.7, then explicit named source rows joined to current training; not advertised as an independent second digitization algorithm.
